title: Ship It: Build, Test & Deploy AI-Powered Apps with GitHub Copilot and Azure AI Foundry
speaker: Werner Rall
abstract: Go from a blank VS Code window to a production-ready, AI-powered cloud app live on stage using Copilot agent mode, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure AI Foundry and MCP.

title: Getting Started with GitHub Copilot Agent Mode
speaker: Alice Nkosi
abstract: Learn how agent mode plans and executes multi-step coding tasks, edits across files, and runs your tests — all from natural language.

title: Designing Globally Distributed Apps with Azure Cosmos DB
speaker: Bongani Dlamini
abstract: Partitioning, consistency levels, serverless vs provisioned throughput, and keyless access with managed identity.

title: Model Context Protocol: Grounding Copilot in Your Live Data
speaker: Chen Wei
abstract: Build an MCP server that exposes your application's data as tools GitHub Copilot can query in real time.

title: Keyless Azure: Managed Identity and Microsoft Entra ID Everywhere
speaker: Thandiwe Mokoena
abstract: Stop shipping secrets. Use DefaultAzureCredential, user-assigned managed identities, and data-plane RBAC for Cosmos DB and Azure AI Foundry.

title: From Localhost to Container Apps with azd
speaker: Pieter van der Merwe
abstract: One command up, one command down. Infrastructure as Code with Bicep and the Azure Developer CLI for repeatable deployments.

title: Building Code-First AI Agents on Azure AI Foundry
speaker: Fatima Patel
abstract: Create, run and orchestrate agents with the GA Persistent Agents SDK — threads, runs, tools and grounding.

title: Testing and Code Coverage with Copilot
speaker: Sipho Khumalo
abstract: Let Copilot generate xUnit tests, wire up coverage, and keep your pull requests green.
